faq.question: How often should I schedule pest control services for my home?
faq.answer: The frequency of pest control services for your Wilmington home largely depends on the specific pest situations you are facing and the time of year. As a general guideline, we recommend having preventive pest control treatments at least quarterly in order to stay ahead of potential infestations, particularly for pests that are prevalent in our coastal environment. However, if you experience an infestation, we advise you to call us immediately to address the problem. Our team can assess your individual needs and provide a recommended schedule that keeps your home protected year-round.

faq.question: Are your pest control methods safe for families and pets?
faq.answer: Absolutely! At Jay Taylor Exterminating, we are deeply concerned about the safety of your family and pets, which is why we use pest control methods that prioritize health and safety. Our technicians are trained to apply pest management techniques in a way that minimizes exposure to harmful substances. We utilize environmentally friendly solutions whenever possible and adhere to all safety regulations to ensure that the products we use are effective yet safe. You can confidently enjoy your home without worrying about the well-being of your loved ones when you choose us for your pest control needs.
